# S3 Control

Manage general purpose bucket tags through S3 Control using the same bucket records as S3.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `s3control` |
| Signing name | `s3` |
| Wire protocol | REST XML |
| API version | `2018-08-20` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Bucket tagging only |
| Selected operations | 3 of 97 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#s3-control) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- All other S3 Control operations are outside the profile, including access points, batch jobs, Storage Lens and Access Grants.
- Only commercial general purpose bucket ARNs are supported; other resource ARNs fail explicitly.
- SDKs prefix the endpoint host with the account ID, so the endpoint must be a name under localhost (or another name that resolves with any prefix); an IP address endpoint cannot reach S3 Control.
- The pinned S3ResourceArn pattern excludes regionless bucket ARNs; the generator rewrites it to also accept arn:aws:s3:::bucket, as AWS does.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `ListTagsForResource` | `GET /v20180820/tags/{ResourceArn+}` |
| `TagResource` | `POST /v20180820/tags/{ResourceArn+}` |
| `UntagResource` | `DELETE /v20180820/tags/{ResourceArn+}` |
